# yyjson 0.12.0

Unmodified files from the upstream `0.12.0` tag:

[Release](https://github.com/ibireme/yyjson/releases/tag/0.12.0) · [API documentation](https://ibireme.github.io/yyjson/doc/doxygen/html/api.html)

License: MIT; see `LICENSE`. The HTTP adapter will use strict JSON mode,
length-aware strings, native integer parsing and bounded per-request allocators.
